== example.com/one
  Permissions:
    datastore.entities.get                        datastore.Client.Get, datastore.Client.Run
    datastore.entities.list                       datastore.Client.Run
    storage.objects.create                        storage.ObjectHandle.NewWriter
  Conditional permissions:
    storage.objects.delete                        storage.ObjectHandle.NewWriter
  APIs: datastore.googleapis.com, storage.googleapis.com
  Notes:
    datastore.Client.Run: keys-only queries need only datastore.entities.list
    storage.ObjectHandle.NewWriter: storage.objects.delete is needed to overwrite an existing object
  Unmapped SDK calls (add rules to table.go):
    cloud.google.com/go/spanner.Client.Single
      one/db.go:3
      one/db.go:9
  Call sites:
    cloud.google.com/go/datastore.Client.Get
      one/main.go:10
      one/main.go:20
    cloud.google.com/go/datastore.Client.Run
      one/query.go:5

      one/upload.go:7
